description: macOS platform guide for the agent-desktop CLI. Use for desktop automation on macOS: granting Accessibility and Screen Recording permission (TCC), what headed mode does on macOS (physical-first click, type and scroll), surfaces (menu, menubar, sheet, popover, alert), Notification Center, Chromium and Electron apps including launch --cdp, and fixing PERM_DENIED, empty accessibility trees, ACTION_FAILED and APP_UNRESPONSIVE.
